snippet.title: Demo release Trailer - BARREL ROLL - Rubika
snippet.description:
HERE WE ARE ! Barrel Roll Demo is out ! 

Barrel Roll is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilding game. The deck ? We replaced it with a revolver’s barrel ! Customize it with powerful bullets to take down as many outlaws as you can. 

You think you’re up for the challenge ? Come play the demo and share your experience with us on our social media. 🤠

You want to support the game ? Here’s what you can do:
- Play the demo
- Wishlist the game on Steam
- Talk about it around you
- Join us on our social media

Play here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941140/Barrel_Roll_Demo/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/barrelroll_official
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@barrelroll_official
